Class ProtocolErrorMapper

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsoft.mesos.server.network.connectionHandling.ProtocolErrorMapper
public final class ProtocolErrorMapper extends Object
Maps errors caught at the network boundary to protocol error payloads.

This class is used by TCP and RMI virtual views when a client message fails before it can be accepted by the application controllers. Its architectural role is to keep transport-level error reporting consistent: both network protocols convert parsing, protocol, or unexpected runtime failures into the same ErrorPayload format.

The mapper only describes failures detected at the network boundary. Application and domain errors are produced later by controllers or models and are not mapped here.

  • Method Details

    • toErrorPayload

      public static ErrorPayload toErrorPayload(RuntimeException exception)
      Converts a runtime exception raised at the network boundary into an error payload that can be sent to the client.

      Invalid client input is reported as INVALID_MESSAGE. Unexpected server-side failures are hidden behind INTERNAL_ERROR, so clients receive a stable protocol response instead of Java exception details.

      Parameters:
      exception - exception caught while processing a client message at the transport boundary
      Returns:
      protocol error payload to send back to the client
